en.html:
Chachamaru Ashikaga had said she would give me a chance to kill Hikaru.

...What did that mean?

The ruler of Horigoe apparently did possess some unusual power. And naturally she had the authority to move tens of thousands of soldiers as she wished.

Use all of it against Silver Star, and still she could not defeat her.
So I thought.

Yet—

My heart beat violently.
An ill foreboding prickled over my skin.

<ruby>Chachamaru Ashikaga was not lying<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>.
That certainty frightened me.

If her words were true, I would be able to take what I wanted.

Hikaru's life.

The moment I had waited for was near.

............That was why I was afraid.

ja.html:
足利茶々丸は、光を殺す機会を与えると言った。

　……どういう事なのか。

　堀越公方に何らかの異能があるのはどうやら事実だ。
　そして無論、数万の兵力を意のままに動かす権力も
所有している。

　だがそのすべてを駆使して銀星号に挑もうと、討ち
果たす事は叶うまい。
　そう思う。

　なのに、

　……心臓が激しい動悸を訴える。

　不吉な予感に肌がぷつぷつ粟立つ。

　<ruby>足利茶々丸は嘘を言っていない<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。
　その確信に、俺は恐怖する。

　彼女の言葉が嘘でないなら、俺は望み通り奪えると
いう事なのだ。

　光の命を。

　待ち望んだ瞬間が近い。

　…………だから恐れている。

No. Even if she still slept, it made no difference. I could not believe such a simple method would kill her.

Then we ought to stop.
Better to stop...

Chachamaru Ashikaga slid the door open.

Dark inside.
A vast emptiness, like the sea at night.

But as my eyes adjusted, I saw a room <ruby>almost<rt>almost</rt></ruby> the same as the one assigned to me. A few furnishings. Good tatami covering the floor.

—At the center, <ruby>something white<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>.

I had seen this before.

その戸を、足利茶々丸は引き開けた。

　中は暗い。
　夜の海のように、茫漠と無が広がっている。

　しかしやがて目が慣れるにつれて、そこは俺にあて
がわれた部屋と<ruby>殆<rt>ほとん</rt></ruby>ど変わりない一室だと知れた。
　そう多くない調度品。上質の畳が敷き詰められた床。

　――中央には、<ruby>白い何か<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>。

　既視感。
